'''Demesel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains in the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]], presumably in the [[Demesel system/Legends|Demesel system]]. Its local [[Standard day/Legends|day]] was 22 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long; its year was 285 local days long. It was a trading hub of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] settled by a consortium of [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] businesses. With the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet lost its importance, becoming a backwater. It became the headquarters of the [[Glasfir Ring/Legends|Glasfir Ring]], which took over the local underworld, eliminating [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] competition. The local government was coerced by [[Glasfir'a'lik]] to leave the crime ring alone.
